note.summary:
1.3 Education and work
Key focus
- school subjects, lessons, teachers, study routines and future careers.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Distinguish present habits from completed past actions and future intentions; make comparisons accurately.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: My favourite subject is science because the experiments are interesting.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“La mia materia preferita è la scienza perché gli esperimenti sono interessanti.”

Which subject is preferred, and why?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: On Tuesday I handed in a history assignment late.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Martedì ho consegnato un compito di storia in ritardo.”

Which assignment was handed in late, and when?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I study in the library for two hours a day before exams.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Studio in biblioteca due ore al giorno prima degli esami.”

Where and for how long does the speaker study before exams?

questions.modelAnswer: Our teacher explains slowly and is always available.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Il nostro professore spiega lentamente ed è sempre disponibile.”

Give two positive features of the teacher.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Last year I worked in a shop for three weeks.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“L’anno scorso ho lavorato in un negozio per tre settimane.”

Where did the speaker work last year, and for how long?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: After university I would like to become an engineer and travel for work.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Dopo l’università vorrei diventare ingegnere e viaggiare per lavoro.”

What career does the speaker want, and what does the future job involve?
